title: Laundry Room Still Life
description: A stacked white washer and dryer unit with visible wear stands against a plain wall. To the right is a small white chest freezer labeled 'FROZEN STORAGE ONLY', with a shelf above holding bottles of bleach, detergent, and spot remover, plus a broom leaning against the appliances.
prompt: A realistic still life painting of a worn stacked washer and dryer unit against a plain wall. The dryer door has yellow text reading HEAVY DUTY. To the right sits a white chest freezer labeled FROZEN STORAGE ONLY. Above it, a shelf holds large jugs of bleach, detergent concentrate, and spot remover. A broom with straw bristles leans against the machines. Muted palette with visible paint texture and signs of wear.
